note: Where the top region goes, per facing (brief 2). `scene` is the rave's scene id. While placeholder.active is true each of those ids is a PLACEHOLDER node of content/paths/bedsit/run.json that resolves to the bedsit itself. TO LAND THE REAL RAVES: set placeholder.active to false here, and delete the four nodes with "placeholder": true from run.json (or regenerate it from tools/run/make_bedsit.py after replacing PLACEHOLDER_RAVES).
